title: SmimeError lacks #[non_exhaustive]: adding variants is breaking
description: SmimeError is a public enum without #[non_exhaustive]. Every new error variant (already happened: WrongContentType, AllSignersFailed) is a breaking change — downstream callers with exhaustive match arms fail to compile. Same applies to KeyEncryptionAlgorithm, DigestAlgorithm, KariKeyAgreement, KeyWrapAlgorithm, TransferEncoding, EcCurve. Add #[non_exhaustive] to all public enums before 1.0 or first wide adoption.
